“I LOVE not having to think about which fruit and veg to buy!”

Getting a weekly (or fortnightly) fruit and veg box from An Apple A Day is one of the simplest swaps you’ll make to reduce your mental load. Here’s how it works:

🍏 STEP 1: Pick your box size
Small, Medium or Large, depending on your household. Mixed fruit and veg, just veggies, or just fruit. Order it once, or subscribe weekly or fortnightly, whatever suits your rhythm. You can pause any time.

🥕 STEP 2: Tell us what you don’t want
Every week there’s a Swaps Box in store. Something you don’t like? Swap it. Already got too much of something? Swap them. There’s nothing to weird or wonderful - just take home the things your family will actually eat.

🌽 STEP 3: Pick up or get it delivered
Pop into our Tighes Hill store seven days a week, or have it delivered anywhere from Mayfield to Belmont.

🍋 STEP 4: Open the fridge and feel good all week!
It’s full of beautiful, fresh produce that lasts, and suddenly lunchboxes and dinner aren’t a scramble anymore because there’s always staples to build a meal around.

The whole thing takes less time than half a lap of the supermarket fruit and veg aisle, and the produce is guaranteed fresh.

Pop instore and check them out, or just order a box online. You’re going to love it!

I find that ordering a veg box really great for the below 3 reasons

1- It always includes a vegetable I would never pick up at the grocery store and forces me to cook with it. This week I received a kohlrabi. No idea what I should so with it but I did come across a gorgeous looking recipe in Frankie @moodymangoalchemy new book and may put that to the test this week and make a tahini and kohlrabi salad … Any other idea please do let me know below. I have 2 …

2- I order a UK only veg box and that way everything included in it is seasonal. This week I got some wild garlic. Again, forces you to use ingredients in season, which taste their best and seasonal fruit and vegetables have been also shown to contain more antioxidants and so you also get more bang for your buck. 

3- Your are supporting local farmers and small businesses 

I don’t order one weekly, which I would love to but I know when I do order one I need to put some thought into ingredients and how I can use them. 
 I’m a creature of habit, I’m drawn to the same ingredients and so I find this really helps me.  A simple way to support my gut, hormones and skin health.

Studies show that good gut diversity is so important for health. Good gut diversity comes from eating a variety of plant foods (fruits, vegetables, nuts, seeds, herbs, legumes, grains., beans etc). Trying something new is a great way to support this. If you don’t order a veg box then next time you go to the supermarket make an effort to pick up something you wouldn’t usually try.
Also remember that different types of the same food count as different foods for your microbes so simple ways like a green apple instead of a red one or blackberries instead of blueberries are another way to get in some diversity and support gut health
